verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs explicitly describe a dedicated test Customer Area, test cards, and a basic testing system to simulate various POS transaction scenarios (declines, card brands, CVMs) without using production data. This clearly supports sandbox-based development/testing separate from production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the sandbox is fully isolated from production billing/data, and no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific sandbox tooling beyond the general test environment.
